_about: API-05 error scans (tools/api-rules.mjs errorBreaks) over packages/astraeus/src/api/. `throw`: a throw that is not a SceneError (a rethrow of what was caught is not judged). `message`: an error recognised by its message text. One entry per break: reason, review finding (docs/architecture/api-review-2026-11-01.md), Objective expected to remove it. An entry that no longer matches a break fails the test; entries may only be removed.

breaks.site: scene.ts: error.message.startsWith("the planet series are not loaded")
breaks.reason: Recognises an internal error by its message text (and names the non-public loadPlanetSeries())
Recognises an internal RangeError by its message text

breaks.site: data.ts: throw new RangeError(`${source.name}: no moon system for "${positions.centre}"`);
